The institutional investor held 1.80 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $287.14 million, up from 1.45M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Axa who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $559.47B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.37% or $0.71 during the last trading session, reaching $193.28. About 17.05 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
